content: The Palestinian people have been enduring immense hardships for far too long, and the situation has become even more dire in recent times. The struggles they face from displacement to a lack of access to basic necessities—are heart-wrenching. Our fellow Muslims in Palestine are in desperate need of our support, and we must come together as a global community to extend a helping hand.

Alkhidmat Khawateen Trust Pakistan is launching a humanitarian campaign to provide much-needed assistance to Muslim communities in Palestine. We believe in the power of collective action, and with your generous donations, we can make a meaningful impact. Your contribution, no matter the size, will go a long way in providing essential aid including food, clean water, medical supplies, and shelter to those who need it most.
We understand that times are difficult for many, and not everyone is able to contribute financially. However, your support in any form can make a difference.
Thank you for your unwavering support and generosity. Let us stand together in solidarity with the people of Palestine and provide them with the hope and help they so desperately need.

• It becomes a safe roof over her head.
  • It becomes books in her hands.
  • It becomes protection, care, and dignity.
  • It becomes her chance at the future she deserves.

At Aghosh Homes Karachi, orphan girls are not just given shelter; they are given stability, education, nurturing, and the confidence to dream again. For many of them, this is the first place where they have felt safe.
Give it where it helps build a safe tomorrow.
Your Zakat. Her protection. Her education. Her safe tomorrow.
